messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I can see the issue now. Your status bar shows that **mobile data is disabled**, which would prevent you from using your internet connection even though we've added data to your plan.

Let's fix this step by step:

**Step 1:** Please turn on your mobile data by using `toggle_data` on your phone. This will enable your phone to use cellular data for internet access.

After you do that, please check your status bar again and let me know what it shows now (especially whether data is enabled or disabled).

I have turned on my mobile data. Now my status bar shows excellent 4G signal strength, 5G network type, data enabled, VPN connected, and battery at 80%. What should I do next?

Please summarize the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
